title: citrus × limonia otaitensis
intro: Citrus × limonia otaitensis, commonly known as Sudachi or Yuzu, is a species of citrus plant native to the Pacific Islands. Sudachi is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonene, beta-pinene, and limonin, among others, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities. The bioactive compounds present in Sudachi have also been found to have potential applications in the prevention and treatment of various diseases, including cancer and neurodegenerative disorders.
